s.how: Pop 120g kernels. Boil 150g brown sugar, 80g butter and 3 tbsp golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in half a tsp bicarb. Pour over the popcorn, toss and bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15. Cool and break up.

Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk. Pat 8 franks dry and push onto sticks. Dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until deep gold. Serve with mustard.

m.how: Dissolve 80g salt and 80g brown sugar in 2L water with 1 tbsp smoked paprika. Brine 4 turkey drumsticks overnight. Pat dry, rub with more paprika and roast at 150C for 2 hours until the meat pulls easily from the bone.

w.how: Push sticks into 4 apples. Boil 400g sugar, 125ml water and 1 tsp vinegar to 150C, then add a few drops of red colouring. Dip and twirl the apples, then set on baking paper. Serve with a bag of fairy floss.

d.note: the queue on a hot day
d.how: Blitz 200ml blue raspberry cordial with 600ml cold water and 4 cups of ice in a blender until it is smooth and slushy. Pour into four cups and serve straight away with spoon straws before it melts.
